findings.proposal: Prototype foreground NORMAL scope around core synthesis next(), including only known owned Russian child handle; preserve BELOW_NORMAL preparation; restore previous priority before yielding, on cancellation, and on failure. Never use HIGH or REALTIME.
findings.limitations: One constrained owned logical CPU and60%duty synthetic load; four observations per cell, not P95/P99 or real NVDA/audio acceptance. UK/EN PCM bit-identical, RU already non-bit-deterministic with existing seed42 despite identical length; do not claim RU waveform equivalence.

Boundary sample-step metrics are raw waveform diagnostics, not listening acceptance.

findings.proposal: Separately instrument native EN ORT stages and Russian pipe response polling/owned abort; retain speaker/state and prevent stale playback, without claiming protocol ACK equals audible cancellation.
